# wallix-bastion_authdomain_ad (Resource)

Provides an Active Directory authentication domain resource. It depends on a
`wallix-bastion_externalauth_ldap` resource for the actual directory connection, and adds
Active Directory attribute mapping and optional X.509 certificate-based authentication on top.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "wallix-bastion_externalauth_ldap" "corporate" {
  authentication_name = "corporate_ad"
  host                = "dc1.corporate.local"
  port                = 636
  is_ssl              = true
  ldap_base           = "OU=Users,DC=corporate,DC=local"
  cn_attribute        = "sAMAccountName"
  login_attribute     = "sAMAccountName"
  timeout             = 10
  is_anonymous_access = true
}

resource "wallix-bastion_authdomain_ad" "corporate" {
  domain_name          = "corporate.local"
  auth_domain_name     = "corporate.com"
  external_auths       = [wallix-bastion_externalauth_ldap.corporate.authentication_name]
  default_language     = "en"
  default_email_domain = "corporate.com"
  description          = "Corporate Active Directory domain"
}
```

### With X.509 Certificate-Based Authentication

```terraform
resource "wallix-bastion_authdomain_ad" "smartcard" {
  domain_name          = "smartcard.corporate.local"
  auth_domain_name     = "corporate.com"
  external_auths       = [wallix-bastion_externalauth_ldap.corporate.authentication_name]
  default_language     = "en"
  default_email_domain = "corporate.com"

  check_x509_san_email   = true
  pubkey_attribute       = "userCertificate"
  x509_condition         = "AND"
  x509_search_filter     = "(sAMAccountName={login})"
  display_name_attribute = "displayName"
  email_attribute        = "mail"
  group_attribute        = "memberOf"
}
```

## Schema

### Required

- `auth_domain_name` (String)
- `default_email_domain` (String)
- `default_language` (String)
- `domain_name` (String)
- `external_auths` (List of String)

### Optional

- `check_x509_san_email` (Boolean)
- `description` (String)
- `display_name_attribute` (String)
- `email_attribute` (String)
- `group_attribute` (String)
- `is_default` (Boolean)
- `language_attribute` (String)
- `pubkey_attribute` (String)
- `san_domain_name` (String)
- `secondary_auth` (List of String)
- `x509_condition` (String)
- `x509_search_filter` (String)

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

## Usage Notes

### Relationship to externalauth_ldap

`external_auths` references one or more `wallix-bastion_externalauth_ldap.authentication_name`
values, which hold the actual LDAP connection details (host, port, bind credentials, base DN).
This resource layers Active Directory-specific attribute mapping and authentication-domain
settings (default language, default email domain) on top.

### default_language

Must be one of `de`, `en`, `es`, `fr`, `ru`.

### X.509 Attributes Are Optional

`check_x509_san_email`, `pubkey_attribute`, `x509_condition`, and `x509_search_filter` only
matter if you're using certificate/smart-card-based authentication against this domain; omit
them for password-based AD authentication.

## Import

Active Directory authentication domain can be imported using the domain name, e.g.

```shell
terraform import wallix-bastion_authdomain_ad.corporate corporate.local
```
